Replace Iran and generic labels with ‘Ukraine strike,’ ‘U.S.-owned electronics plant,’ ‘Russian drone and missile attack,’ and ‘Ukrainian Air Force.’ Remove AP reporters from people_tags unless the editorial scheme intentionally tags source authors.

fieldissues.issue: The title says the administration punished states and cancelled an infrastructure project, while the body describes a funding freeze and says later filings concerned separate energy-grant terminations.
The account combines two funding actions and uses later grant evidence to imply a motive for the separate New York infrastructure freeze.
The election-interference classification and broad democracy tags imply a proven political motive that the text presents only as a question.

proposedchanges.change: Use ‘Trump Administration Freezes $18 Billion for Two New York Infrastructure Projects.’

Separate the New York infrastructure freeze from the later termination of 284 energy grants. Attribute the court filing’s evidence to those grants and do not infer that it proves the motive for the New York action.
Use a neutral federal-funding or infrastructure category if available. Apply an election-interference label only if the record establishes political targeting of the projects themselves.

evidencebasis: The long says the later filing concerned 284 energy grants, separate from the initial New York announcement. The title states punishment as motive and cancellation as outcome, while the body describes a freeze and raises questions. The packet URL is retained.
notes: Existing record 3932. The title and category state political intent that the described evidence does not establish for the New York projects.
